entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I bought a jersey from you people almost three months ago and it's completely useless. I want my money back. This is ridiculous.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

Are you listening to me?! It's the wrong size! I ordered my usual large and this thing is way too tight. I can barely breathe in it. I want to return it. Now. Or I swear I'm going to leave a review on every website I can find.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the sizing issue. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Sterling. The order number is... VF8675309. You guys better fix this. I spend a lot of money with VeloFit.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I see your account now and I do appreciate your loyalty as a VIP member. I see the ClubFit Jersey was delivered about 80 days ago... Okay, one moment while I check our policy.
Don't give me some runaround about policy. Just process the return. If you can't do it, get me your manager.

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just confirmed, and you're absolutely right to call. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. We can definitely get this processed for you.
Well, it's about time. So what are my options? Can I just get an exchange for the right size?

Absolutely. Since the current jersey is too tight, we can process a direct exchange for the next size up. I'm generating a pre-paid return label for you right now, which I'll email over. As a thank you for your patience and as a valued VIP customer, I'll also have the new size shipped out with complimentary express shipping.
Okay... fine. Express shipping, you said? That's better. Make sure you send that email right away.
I've just sent it, Mr. Sterling. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just make sure it gets here quickly.
We will. Thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
